transcript: Welcome to our Spanish class. Today you will learn how to order with confidence at a restaurant. La carta, el menú, el menú del día. In Spain, the word for word for the menu can be tricky. If you you want the printed list of dishes, ask for la carta because there, the other word usually means a fixed price lunch, el menú, el menú del día. To order, you can say I would like, or when the waiter comes around the table, say for me, the chicken, quisiera, para mí el pollo, el mesero, la cuenta, por favor. When the food arrives, wish everyone an enjoyable meal, at the end, ask for the check, and leave a tip. Buen provecho. La cuenta. La propina. Paella valenciana
